rows.plan: Agent shell -> TinySecurity SandboxPlan2/ConsumeSandboxPlan2; module chooses TinyBox or an explicitly operator-disabled host run outside SaaS
rows.note: Agent is registered TrustedHost; direct host execution is reachable only through a consumed host_run plan after operator-off facts. Untrusted hook/scheduled text uses sandbox::untrusted and the module refuses host_run (untrusted_tests.rs; spawn_plan/integration_tests.rs untrusted_text_never_gets_a_run_on_the_host).

rows.plan: scheduled shell jobs, command hooks and TinyFlows code-node scripts -> TinySecurity SandboxPlan2/ConsumeSandboxPlan2 and TinyBox jail or Docker; refused below the isolation floor
rows.note: the shared gate is called by cron shell jobs, command hooks and flows/caps_host/code.rs; flow scripts pass their DispatchCtx explicitly. It has no unjailed branch: the operator's switch is declared to the module, which plans a run on the host only for the trusted operator, never for untrusted source or under SaaS
fixed argv: `node --version` / `python3 --version`, no skill-supplied text reaches the command

modules.route: User-authored command hooks -> HookEnvironment CommandSpawner -> OpenHuman SandboxedHookSpawner -> TinySecurity plan -> TinyBox jail; refused when the isolation floor is unavailable
modules.note: OpenHuman does not install the engine's legacy synchronous shell fallback; command hooks require the host spawner

modules.route: MCP servers installed from the registry, and every stdio server under SaaS: StdioSpawner -> JailedSpawner -> tinybox StartStdio (tinybox-bus 1.21), enforcement Enforced with the untrusted-code isolation floor and the credential-store deny_read; refused when no backend meets it
modules.note: the module refuses a stdio server that is neither operator_trusted nor given a stdio_sandbox, so there is no unconfined fallback (tinymcp transport/stdio/jailed_tests.rs)

modules.route: stdio servers declared in the operator's own [mcp_client.servers]: direct child process, operator_trusted set by mcp::host::client_config, never under SaaS
